To determine if the chance of `glimx` is smaller when observing `zuph`, we must compare the marginal probability of `glimx`, denoted as $P(\text{glimx})$, with the conditional probability of `glimx` given `zuph`, denoted as $P(\text{glimx} \mid \text{zuph})$.

    $$P(\text{glimx}) = P(\text{zuph}, \text{glimx}) + P(\text{not zuph}, \text{glimx})$$
